what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Peru in Ecuador: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 64 Peruvian asylum seekers in Ecuador, 0.1% of all asylum seekers from Peru.
Refugees from Peru, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Canada, Spain and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Peru with Sendero Luminoso from 1996 to 1999 and from 2007 to 2010.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2009 and 2010, fall within the second period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 8 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 5156, at the end of 2009, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Ecuador.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Ecuador only.
